items.headline: Energy prices rise after Trump’s ‘energy ceasefire’ fails to move Russia or Ukraine
items.detail: Oil and gas prices rose Monday after an “energy ceasefire” announced by President Donald Trump on Sunday failed to gain traction.

items.headline: Key inflation reports will reveal read on U.S. economy ahead of midterms
items.detail: Two key reports on consumer and producer pricing will provide a final read on the U.S. economy before the midterms. NBC News’ Allie Canal details what to watch as the reports are released.

items.headline: RJ Mitte, actor best known for playing Walter White Jr. on ‘Breaking Bad,’ dies at 34
items.detail: Mitte played the son of the teacher-turned-meth producer in the hit series.

items.headline: Omar’s home searched as part of federal criminal investigation
items.detail: Federal agents carried out a search warrant on Democratic Congresswoman Ilhan Omar’s home in Washington as part of a federal criminal investigation. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.

items.headline: One dead at Six Flags park in Georgia
items.detail: An emergency on the Goliath roller coaster at the Six Flags outside Atlanta led to evacuations from the ride and passengers having to climb a steep descent. Authorities say one person was killed at the park and several others injured.

outlets.name: The Hill

items.headline: Newsom backs California ballot measure that cancels out billionaire tax proposal
items.detail: California Gov. Gavin Newsom (D) endorsed a ballot measure that, if approved by voters, would cancel out the ballot measure proposal that would impose a one-time tax on the Golden State's billionaires.

items.headline: Sanders calls for artificial superintelligence ban after OpenAI CEO interview
items.detail: Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.) on Monday called for permanently banning artificial superintelligence in response to recent remarks made by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

items.headline: Mamdani: citizenship ‘should not be weaponized’ against Omar
items.detail: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani (D) on Monday slammed the federal search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's (D-Minn.) Washington, D.C., home, saying that her citizenship "should not be weaponized" against her.

items.headline: Trump repeatedly attacks Minnesota, Omar during Ohio campaign stop
items.detail: President Trump repeatedly brought up Minnesota and Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-Minn.) on Monday night while stumping for Republicans in Ohio ahead of the midterms.

items.headline: Spicer says he's ‘absolutely’ concerned about Kansas Senate race
items.detail: Former White House press secretary Sean Spicer on Monday said he is "absolutely" concerned about Republicans losing the Kansas Senate race, which election handicappers say could flip in favor of the Democrats.

items.detail: Institutionalized mental health care is “outdated” and “a human rights issue hiding in plain sight,” write Anura Kumara Dissanayake and Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.

items.headline: ‘Other Mommy’ Nips ‘Verity’ in Photo Finish for U.K., Ireland Box Office Summit
items.detail: Universal’s horror entry “Other Mommy,” directed by Rob Savage and starring Jessica Chastain and Jay Duplass, squeaked to the top of the U.K. and Ireland box office in a dead heat, debuting at No. 1 with £1.97 million ($2.66 million).

items.detail: Speaking at the Bloomberg's New Economic Forum, India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that India is the mother of democracy where a wide range of issues are debated openly.

items.headline: India and the Reordered World
items.detail: Bloomberg's Stephanie Flanders, Chetna Kumar, John Micklethwait and Mishal Husain discuss India’s role amid shifting global power, trade and technology at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Modi Pitches India as Reliable Partner: Speech in Hindi
items.detail: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi says global supply chains, trade and technology are increasingly being used as tools of coercion, and declared that his country stands apart.

items.headline: Human Intelligence in a Hostile World
items.detail: Tom Orlik, Chief Economist, Bloomberg Economics examines the role of human intelligence in navigating an increasingly hostile world at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: LVMH Sales in Mainland China Fall by Double Digits
items.detail: LVMH's sales in mainland China dropped by double digits in the third quarter, adding to doubts about the durability of a broader luxury recovery. Bloomberg's Angelina Rascouet reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
